dgp: A=2+sin(.71*i)+.2*cos(.13*i); B=.7*cos(1.13*i)+.4*e; Y=5+2*A-.5*B+.3*e; V=1+.25*A+1.5*B+.9*e; i=0..799; e=sum of 12 uniforms minus 6 from one 64-bit LCG stream (B over all rows, then Y, then V)

oracle.method: linear law in `dgp`: the structural slope of Y on A is its coefficient 2, so the point derivative, the central finite difference of the identified intervention levels and the observed-weight average derivative equal 2; the elasticity, semi-elasticities, Jacobian and directional derivative follow from the coefficients at A = 2, B = 0
asserted_outputs: point, elasticity, semi_treatment, semi_outcome, average (published value and finite difference of levels), the planted off-support point
context_only_outputs: jacobian and directional (carried for the reference; the refuter states assert the scalar coordinates)
fixture_id and dgp text (checked only as a guard on the model used)

reference_review.limitations: The law is linear, so every derivative is constant and the fixture cannot detect curvature errors. The elasticity and outcome-scale semi-elasticity assume B = 0 at the evaluation point, as the neighbouring derivative fixture does. The tolerances are declared estimation bands. The refuter verdicts themselves (support, finite difference, resampling stability, predictive checks) are asserted against these truths, not derived by the reference. No uncertainty or calibration.
